description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class CsvDataImportFactoryTest for testing the CsvDataImportFactory class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It verifies that the factory correctly produces instances of PimCsvDataImport when requested.

classes.name: CsvDataImportFactoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of CsvDataImportFactory, specifically its ability to instantiate the correct import class based on a string identifier.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new CsvDataImportFactory object before each test.

methods.name: testGetImportClassInstance
methods.description: Tests that the factory method getImportClassInstance returns an instance of PimCsvDataImport when given the string 'pim'.
